regulation_clause.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

final_instance.gold_rationale: The 2016 clause requires entitlement to more than 15 percent of capital or profits. WS-EXCESS-PCT = WS-ENTITLEMENT-PCT - 15 (line 17) is positive exactly when entitlement strictly exceeds 15, read as a resolved combined capital-or-profits figure per the adjudication note.

regulation_clause.text: The sanctioned credit limit shall not be breached at any point in time without explicit consent from the cardholder.

final_instance.gold_rationale: Clause 12(5) conditions breach on explicit consent (breach -> consent). 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT rejects any transaction that would exceed ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT (lines 403-411) and the main loop never posts a failed transaction (lines 211-216), making the antecedent always false and the conditional vacuously satisfied, per the adjudication note.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-27: Pass 1 read the blanket rejection of over-limit transactions as conformant (D7); Pass 2 read the absent consent-capture path as a missing rule (D2). Resolved on the clause's own grammar: 'shall not be breached... without explicit consent' is the conditional breach -> consent. CBTRN02C's 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT makes the antecedent always false (no transaction that would breach the limit is ever posted, lines 403-411 reject it via WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON=102, and the main loop never posts a failed transaction, lines 211-216), which satisfies the conditional regardless of whether a distinct consent mechanism exists. The cited text conditions breach on consent; it does not separately mandate that a consent-gated override path be offered. Pass 1's reading is accepted.

regulation_clause.text: Interest shall be levied only on the outstanding amount, adjusted for payments, refunds and reversed transactions.

final_instance.gold_rationale: Clause 23(6) requires interest be levied only on the outstanding amount, adjusted for payments, refunds, and reversed transactions. CBACT04C's 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST computes interest directly from TRAN-CAT-BAL (lines 464-466). Per adjudication cross-reference to CBTRN02C (the program maintaining TCATBAL-FILE), TRAN-CAT-BAL is accumulated via signed ADD DALYTRAN-AMT (2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC, line 527), and DALYTRAN-AMT is confirmed signed by the adjacent IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 branch in 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC (line 548). Signed accumulation nets offsetting payment/refund/reversal entries into the category balance by construction, satisfying the clause's adjustment requirement.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-28: both passes independently reached needs_adjudication, citing insufficient evidence from CBACT04C alone about whether TRAN-CAT-BAL already nets payments, refunds, and reversed transactions. Cross-referencing the sibling real-curated candidate CBTRN02C in the same evidence bundle (the program that posts to TCATBAL-FILE) resolves this: CBTRN02C's 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC accumulates the category balance via 'ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL', and 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC's 'IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0' branch (immediately following) confirms DALYTRAN-AMT is a signed amount -- positive for debits/purchases, negative for credits/payments/refunds/reversals. Signed accumulation means TRAN-CAT-BAL already reflects netting of offsetting entries by construction, before CBACT04C ever reads it. This is decisive primary evidence within the same bundle, not external or historical evidence, so the needs_adjudication gap is resolved rather than defaulted to exclude.
